title: BridgeDeckAgentManifest
description: Canonical Manifest Schema for Bridge Deck multi-vendor agents with secure-by-default ACL and 3-Tier memory.

id.description: Unique, lowercase alphanumeric identifier for the agent.

name.description: Canonical human-readable display name of the agent.

role.description: Functional job title and role in Bridge Deck.

system_prompt.description: Core identity instructions, constraints, and behavioral directives.

access_read.description: List of authorized base filesystem directories the agent has permission to read.

derived_read.description: List of filesystem directories dynamically derived from active project memberships.

access_write.description: List of authorized filesystem directories the agent has permission to modify. Default is empty (read-only).

access_notes.description: Human-readable notes clarifying access scope boundaries.

skills.description: List of preferred tools and agent skills.

harness.description: Agent Execution Harness (e.g. voyager for workspace tool execution and grounding).

tools_enabled.description: Explicit operator-authorized list of workspace tools enabled for this agent (e.g. ['run_command']).

silo.description: Semantic memory siloing tier (private maps to memory/semantic/<agent_id>/).

shared_access.description: Projects from which the agent reads shared common-ground decisions.

type.description: Provider adapter responsible for executing turns for this agent.

model.description: Model ID to invoke on the provider (e.g. claude-opus-5, gemini-2.5-flash).

endpoint_id.description: Vertex AI Custom Endpoint ID or full resource path.

location.description: GCP Region / location (e.g. us-central1, global, europe-west1).
